questions.question: You are building a Python application that transcribes a WAV file by using the Speech SDK. Which class should you use?

options.why: Correct. SpeechRecognizer converts audio from a file or microphone into text.
SpeechSynthesizer converts text into speech.
TextAnalyticsClient analyzes written text.
AIProjectClient connects to a Foundry project, not to speech recognition.

questions.explanation: SpeechRecognizer with an AudioConfig that points to the file performs speech to text.

questions.scenario: A railway application reads booking confirmations aloud. Users report that the ten-digit booking reference is spoken too quickly. You must slow down only the reference number.
questions.question: What should you use?

options.text: SSML with a prosody element that reduces the rate
options.why: Correct. SSML prosody can change the speaking rate for part of the text.
Recognition language affects speech to text, not synthesized speech.
Continuous recognition is for transcribing long audio.
Diarization labels speakers in transcriptions.

questions.explanation: SSML gives fine control over rate, pitch, pauses and style for specific parts of the spoken output.

questions.question: An application calls recognize_once_async on a ten-minute recording and returns only the first sentence. What should you use instead?

options.why: Correct. These approaches process long audio beyond a single utterance.
Neural voices are used for text to speech.
speak_text_async synthesizes speech from text.
Temperature is a generative model parameter and does not apply to speech recognition.

questions.explanation: recognize_once handles a single utterance of up to about 30 seconds. Long audio needs continuous recognition or batch transcription.

questions.question: Which TWO settings can you configure on a SpeechConfig object in the Speech SDK?

options.why: Correct. This property selects the neural voice for text to speech.
Correct. This property sets the language for speech to text, such as en-IN.
Temperature belongs to generative model requests.
Conversation IDs are used with Foundry agents and responses.

questions.explanation: SpeechConfig holds connection details plus the recognition language and synthesis voice.

questions.question: A company wants an application to read product announcements aloud in a natural, human-like voice in Hindi. Which capability should it use?

options.text: Text to speech with a neural voice such as hi-IN-SwaraNeural
options.why: Correct. Neural voices produce natural speech in many languages, including Hindi.

options.text: Speech to text with custom speech
options.why: Speech to text transcribes audio and does not produce spoken output.
Key phrase extraction finds the main points in text.
Translation converts between languages but is not required to speak Hindi text aloud.

questions.explanation: Text to speech with a neural voice converts text into natural-sounding speech.
